ohtani.title: Cardinals crush five homers in win over Dodgers
ohtani.blurb: Thomas Saggese belts two of the five home runs by the Cardinals to lead the offense past the Dodgers in a 13-8 win\n

imanaga.title: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer in Reds' win
imanaga.blurb: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer along with three other Reds in their 7-5 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Christian Yelich's HR powers Brewers past Cubs, 9-4
suzuki.blurb: Christian Yelich and Joey Ortiz club home runs and the Brewers notch 13 hits to  Brewers past Cubs, 9-4

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Gavin Williams twirls a gem in the Guardians 6-1 win
okamoto.blurb: Gavin Williams strikes out 13 batters and Angel Genao hits a pinch-hit, two-run homer to fuel the Guardians' 6-1 victory over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Montgomery, Grichuk power White Sox to 5-1 win
murakami.blurb: Colson Montgomery, Randal Grichuk each hit two-run doubles, plus Sean Burke twirls 5 2/3 scoreless innings in the White Sox 5-1 win

matsui.title: Jose Trevino comes through late in Reds' 4-3 win
matsui.blurb: Jose Trevino hits a go-ahead single in the 8th and Nick Lodolo tosses six strong innings in the Reds' 4-3 win over the Padres
